topic: Aircraft Documentation: Up-keeping various a/c servicing forms & Component Log cards (Passports), Calculation of Flying hrs & Component hour
syllabus_extract: Aircraft Documentation: Up-keeping various a/c servicing forms & Component Log cards (Passports), Calculation of Flying hrs & Component hours, Recording & Certification of relevant servicing work entries in respective columns of servicing forms, Forecasting of Inspection/ Servicing, Disposal / Destruction of a/c documents, Common errors in documentation, Do’s and Don’ts.
specific_objectives: 38.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain principles of Correct Aircraft Maintenance Practices, tools and their usage
